source_quote: Stop irrigation about a fortnight before maturity.
operation_text: Stop irrigation about a fortnight before maturity.
conditions_text: Only when the crop is about a fortnight before maturity.

source_title: Package of Practices for Crops of Punjab — Kharif 2026
source_quote: Harvesting should be done at proper maturity and variety-wise. Avoid harvesting during night.
operation_text: Harvesting should be done at proper maturity and variety-wise. Avoid harvesting during night.
conditions_text: Only when proper maturity is observed for the variety.

source_title: Package of Practices for Crops of Punjab — Rabi 2025–26
source_quote: Harvest and thresh wheat as soon as fully ripe, to avoid grain shattering. Delayed harvesting results in high grain losses.
operation_text: Harvest and thresh wheat as soon as fully ripe, to avoid grain shattering.
method_text: Harvest manually, with a combine, or with a tractor-operated vertical conveyer reaper windrower as documented in the source.
conditions_text: Only when the wheat is fully ripe.

source_title: Improved Technologies and Recommendations for Maximizing Soybean Productivity
source_quote: In soybean, use of fertilizers is recommended only as basal application. Therefore, farmers are advised not to use any fertilizers in standing crop unless being recommended by the scientists.
operation_text: Use fertilizer only as basal application; do not use fertilizer in a standing crop unless recommended by scientists.
dose_text: No farm-specific dose; the source says the dose should be tailored after soil testing.
conditions_text: Only at sowing and only as a regional baseline; a personalised dose requires a soil test.

source_title: Improved Technologies and Recommendations for Maximizing Soybean Productivity
source_quote: When 90% of the pods changes its color to yellow, it is the right indication to go for harvesting.
operation_text: Harvest when 90% of pods change colour to yellow.
conditions_text: Only when 90% yellow-pod maturity is observed.

source_title: Improved Technologies and Recommendations for Maximizing Soybean Productivity
source_quote: To maintain viability of seed and to avoid loss/mechanical damage, threshing should be done at 350-400 rpm.
operation_text: Thresh soybean at 350–400 rpm.
conditions_text: Only after soybean has been harvested and threshing is being performed.

source_title: ICAR-IISR weekly advisory for soybean farmers, 1–7 July 2024
source_quote: Sowing may be done after the onset of monsoon and receipt of 100 mm rainfall.
operation_text: Sow after monsoon onset and receipt of 100 mm rainfall.
conditions_text: Only if sowing has not yet occurred, monsoon onset is documented, and 100 mm rainfall has been received.

source_title: ICAR-IISR weekly advisory for soybean farmers, 1–7 July 2024
source_quote: Farmers are advised to apply the recommended quantity of all the nutrients (25:60:40:20 N:P2O5:K2O:S kg/ha) at the time of sowing only.
operation_text: Apply the Central Zone regional nutrient baseline at sowing only.
method_text: The source permits broadcasting just before sowing or use of a seed-cum-fertilizer drill.
conditions_text: Only at actual sowing; this is a regional baseline, not a farm-specific prescription.

source_title: TNAU tomato fertigation schedule for hybrids
source_quote: The nutrient requirement for hybrids is 200:250:250 kg of NPK per ha.
operation_text: Use the documented hybrid-tomato drip-fertigation schedule.
method_text: The source applies 75% of P as basal and the remaining nutrients through fertigation in stage-specific splits.
conditions_text: Only for documented tomato hybrids under the documented drip-fertigation system and known crop stage.

source_title: TNAU Agritech tomato fruit-borer integrated management
source_quote: Setup pheromone trap with Helilure at 12/ha
operation_text: Set up Helilure pheromone traps.
conditions_text: Only for an existing tomato crop when the implementation stage is documented.

source_title: TNAU Agritech tomato fruit-borer integrated management
source_quote: Collect and destroy the infected fruits and grown up larvae
operation_text: Collect and destroy infected fruits and grown-up larvae.
conditions_text: Only when fruit borer infestation/infected fruit is observed.

source_title: TNAU Agritech tomato early-blight integrated disease management
source_quote: Removal and destruction of crop debris.
operation_text: Remove and destroy crop debris.
conditions_text: Only where relevant crop debris is present and this disease-management measure is applicable.

source_title: TNAU Agritech tomato early-blight integrated disease management
source_quote: Spray Iprodione 50% WP @ 600 g/ac or Azoxystrobin 23% SC @ 200 ml/ac or Mancozeb 35% SC @ 1 kg/ac
operation_text: Use only the documented early-blight fungicide alternatives after a supported diagnosis.
method_text: Spray one of the source-listed formulations.
dose_text: Iprodione 50% WP 600 g/ac; or Azoxystrobin 23% SC 200 ml/ac; or Mancozeb 35% SC 1 kg/ac.
conditions_text: Only after a supported early-blight diagnosis and applicable labelled/regulatory verification.

source_title: TNAU fall-armyworm management in maize
source_quote: Set up FAW pheromone traps @ 12 nos./ha
operation_text: Set up FAW pheromone traps.
conditions_text: Only for an existing maize crop when the implementation stage is documented.

source_title: TNAU fall-armyworm management in maize
source_quote: Spray azadirachtin 1500 ppm @ 2.5 lit/ha or chlorantraniliprole 18.5 SC @ 200ml/ha (or) flubendiamide 480SC@ 250ml/ha at early stage (15 - 20 DAE).
operation_text: Use a source-listed FAW treatment only at the documented early stage.
method_text: Spray one of the listed source formulations.
dose_text: Azadirachtin 1500 ppm 2.5 L/ha; or chlorantraniliprole 18.5 SC 200 ml/ha; or flubendiamide 480 SC 250 ml/ha.
conditions_text: Only after supported FAW diagnosis/threshold and confirmed 15–20 days-after-emergence stage, with labelled/regulatory verification.

source_title: ICAR Rabi Agro-Advisory for Farmers 2021–22
source_quote: Rainfed chickpea should be sown in first fortnight of October while irrigated chickpea should be sown from last week of October to first week of November.
operation_text: Use the source's rainfed or irrigated chickpea sowing window.
conditions_text: Only before sowing and after the farm's rainfed/irrigated regime is documented.

source_title: ICAR Rabi Agro-Advisory for Farmers 2021–22
source_quote: Apply 135:62.5:50 kg/ ha N:P2O5:K2O for varieties and 250:75:75 kg/ha for hybrids.
operation_text: Use the source's variety- or hybrid-specific regional NPK baseline.
dose_text: 135:62.5:50 kg/ha for varieties; 250:75:75 kg/ha for hybrids.
conditions_text: Only with documented variety/hybrid, actual stage, and a soil test for farm-specific adjustment.

source_title: ICAR Rabi Agro-Advisory for Farmers 2021–22
source_quote: Pin-bollworm management: Place pheromone traps @ 40/ha
operation_text: Place pheromone traps for tomato pin-bollworm management.
conditions_text: Only for an existing tomato crop when the implementation stage and target-pest context are documented.

source_title: ICAR-IISR weekly soybean advisory, 25Sep-01Oct 2023
source_quote: Farmers are advised to harvest early maturing soybean varieties immediately after the 90% pods changes the color to yellow. This will not have adverse effect on the seed germination.
operation_text: Harvest early-maturing soybean immediately after 90% of pods turn yellow.
conditions_text: Only for an observed early-maturing soybean variety with 90% yellow pods.

source_title: ICAR-IISR weekly soybean advisory, 25Sep-01Oct 2023
source_quote: Farmers are advised to harvest their soybean crop while ensuring the possibility of no rains after the harvesting. Otherwise, the harvested crop gets affected due to fungal infection.
operation_text: Harvest only when a decision-time dry post-harvest weather window is supported.
conditions_text: Requires observed harvest readiness and an archived decision-time forecast; historical observed weather is not a forecast.

source_title: ICAR-IISR weekly soybean advisory, 25Sep-01Oct 2023
source_quote: The harvested crop must be threshed after sun drying. If the threshing is to be done later, it should be stored at safe place protecting from rains.
operation_text: Sun-dry harvested soybean before threshing; if delayed, store it in a place protected from rain.
conditions_text: Only after actual harvest and with documented drying/storage conditions.

source_title: ICAR-IISR weekly soybean advisory, 25Sep-01Oct 2023
source_quote: In event of continuous rains, farmers are advised to make necessary drainage arrangement in order to maintain the quality of the soybean produce as a result of logging situation
operation_text: Arrange drainage for a mature soybean field under continuous rain and waterlogging risk.
conditions_text: Only when maturity and field-level continuous-rain/waterlogging conditions are observed.

source_title: ICAR-IISR weekly soybean advisory, 25Sep-01Oct 2023
source_quote: Wherever the crop is of 80-90-day duration or at grain filling stage, the economic loss due to insect-pest-disease will be minimum. Therefore, farmers are advised to spray of insecticide/fungicides considering the crop stage and the intensity of the disease/insect.
operation_text: Do not make a routine spray decision; first verify actual crop stage and disease/insect intensity.
conditions_text: Requires a dated diagnosis/threshold and observed crop stage. This row is a guardrail, not a treatment recommendation.

source_title: ICAR-IISR weekly soybean advisory, 24-30 June 2024
source_quote: Sowing may be done after the onset of monsoon and receipt of 100 mm rainfall.
operation_text: Sow soybean after monsoon onset and receipt of 100 mm rainfall.
conditions_text: Only before actual sowing, after farm-relevant monsoon onset and cumulative rainfall are verified.

source_title: ICAR-IISR weekly soybean advisory, 24-30 June 2024
source_quote: Grow more than 2-3 soybean varieties (having varied maturity duration) instead of one popular soybean variety.
operation_text: Use more than two to three locally recommended soybean varieties with varied maturity duration rather than one popular variety.
conditions_text: Only before sowing with documented local variety suitability and seed availability.

source_title: ICAR-IISR weekly soybean advisory, 24-30 June 2024
source_quote: Farmers are advised to use recommended row spacing of 45 cm and 5-10 cm plant to plant distance at 3-4 cm depth. The seed rate may be followed as 60-70 kg/ha.
operation_text: Use 45 cm rows, 5-10 cm plant spacing, 3-4 cm sowing depth, and 60-70 kg/ha seed rate.
dose_text: 45 cm rows; 5-10 cm plant spacing; 3-4 cm depth; 60-70 kg/ha seed rate.
conditions_text: Only during actual sowing with documented cultivar and field layout.

source_title: ICAR-IISR weekly soybean advisory, 24-30 June 2024
source_quote: As far as possible, try to sow soybean crop on Broad-Bed-Furrow/Ridge-Furrow planting system in order to avoid the risk of yield losses due aberrant weather conditions (drought or scanty/heavy/continued rains).
operation_text: Where feasible, sow soybean using a Broad-Bed-Furrow or Ridge-Furrow planting system.
conditions_text: Only before sowing after field feasibility and planting-system availability are verified.

source_title: ICAR-IISR weekly soybean advisory, 24-30 June 2024
source_quote: Farmers are advised not to mix seed along with fertilizers while sowing. Instead, they may use seed-cum-fertilizer seed drill for sowing OR broadcast the fertilizers just before the sowing.
operation_text: Do not mix seed with fertilizer while sowing; use a seed-cum-fertilizer drill or broadcast fertilizer just before sowing.
method_text: Seed-cum-fertilizer drill or fertilizer broadcast immediately before sowing.
conditions_text: Only during actual sowing and with documented equipment/method.

source_title: ICAR-IISR weekly soybean advisory, 24-30 June 2024
source_quote: Farmers are advised to apply the recommended quantity of all the nutrients (25:60:40:20 N:P2O5:K2O:S kg/ha) at the time of sowing only.
operation_text: Apply the Central Zone nutrient baseline at sowing only.
method_text: Broadcast fertilizer sources just before sowing or use a seed-cum-fertilizer drill during sowing.
conditions_text: Only at actual sowing. This is a regional baseline; a farm-specific adjustment requires a soil test.

source_title: ICAR-IISR weekly soybean advisory, 24-30 June 2024
source_quote: In case of organic soybean production, farmers are advised to use Trichoderma viride + Bradyrhizobium japonicum+PSB cultures/liquid biofertilizer/consortia during sowing operation (Table 1).
operation_text: For organic soybean production, use the listed Trichoderma, Bradyrhizobium japonicum, and PSB culture options during sowing.
dose_text: The quoted line refers to Table 1; no dose is emitted from this record.
conditions_text: Only for documented organic soybean production during actual sowing.

source_title: ICAR-IISR weekly soybean advisory, 24-30 June 2024
source_quote: Growing of soybean with Pigeonpea in 4:2 is found most remunerative in case of rainfed farming systems.
operation_text: For a documented rainfed system, use soybean-pigeonpea intercropping at a 4:2 ratio.
conditions_text: Only before sowing after the rainfed farming system and cropping plan are documented.

source_title: Krishi Darshani 2023
source_quote: हरभरा पीक ११० ते १२० दिवसांमध्ये तयार होते. पीक ओलसर असताना काढणी करू नये. घाटे कडक झाल्यानंतर मग हरभऱ्याची काढणी करून मळणी करावी.
operation_text: Harvest and thresh chickpea only after pods are hard; do not harvest while the crop is wet.
method_text: Harvest only after the documented hard-pod maturity condition is observed.
conditions_text: Only when chickpea maturity/hard pods and crop dryness are actually observed.
